name: Tiana
description: Tiana is an angel and artificer sent by the Church of Serra who revived the Weatherlight's powerstone and became a member of its crew and its pilot.

description_citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

summary.text: Tiana is an angel and artificer sent by the Church of Serra who revived the Weatherlight's powerstone and became a member of its crew and its pilot.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

bio.text: Moved by the Weatherlight's skeleton, Tiana revived the inert Powerstone and agreed to oversee the ship's reconstruction.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

bio.text: She was created in the Cathedral of Serra to guard an irrigation system that was destroyed by the Cabal before she arrived, and the church had no other use for her.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

bio.text: She let the vampire Arvad try the Powerstone as a cure, and with Serra's power she drove her sword into a burning phoenix and pushed it into the sea.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

bio.text: She resolved to serve on the Weatherlight, and her voice guided the ship's rebirth.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

bio.text: She deflected Urgoros's spear to save Liliana, and she and Jhoira kept their crew together.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

bio.text: In 2022 she warned Shanna that the Phyrexian disguise was damaging the Weatherlight, entered the corrupted ship with Shanna, and escaped with Slimefoot and the powerstone.

citations.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

status.text: As of the latest story Tiana is alive, having escaped the Weatherlight with Shanna and Slimefoot as the ship flew away in its transformed state.

citations.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Tiana is moved by the Weatherlight's skeleton, recognizing it as Gerrard's blade.
timeline.quote: It's Gerrard's blade in the portraits.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira notices Tiana crying and suspects her reaction is tied to the ship.
timeline.quote: Why are you crying?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The salvagers prepare a hull seed from Molimo and examine the Powerstone.
timeline.quote: a new hull seed Jhoira had obtained from the tree elemental Molimo

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana revives the inert Powerstone.
timeline.quote: Jhoira felt the shift in the Powerstone, the moment when it came to life again.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira asks Tiana to oversee the reconstruction while she gathers a crew, and Tiana agrees.
timeline.quote: No, I need someone to supervise the reconstruction and protect the workers while I gather a crew.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight is restored and ready to launch.
timeline.quote: The Weatherlight was whole and ready to launch.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff notices a vampire waiting with Tiana.
timeline.quote: Why does she have a vampire with her?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The vampire Arvad swears to serve Jhoira.
timeline.quote: I swear to serve at your side, Captain Jhoira.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana is created in the Cathedral of Serra among angels and clerics.
timeline.quote: Tiana's first conscious thought came as she stood in the Cathedral of Serra

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Lyra tells Tiana she was born in answer to mortals' prayers.
timeline.quote: You are Tiana, and you have been born in answer to the prayers of mortals, for a purpose.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Lyra reveals Tiana's purpose is to guard an irrigation system.
timeline.quote: A very complicated irrigation system.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana sees the portrait of Gerrard and his strange spear.
timeline.quote: The knowledge she had been born with told her that the man with the brown hair and goatee

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana and the angels find the town and the Great Machine destroyed by the Cabal.
timeline.quote: They circled around the plateau and Tiana saw what was left of the Great Machine.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Lyra attributes the destruction to the Cabal.
timeline.quote: This is the work of the Cabal.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana and Hadi repair the Weatherlight's engines on Bogardan.
timeline.quote: Tell Tien she wasn't wrong.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana realizes Serra feeds her knowledge of the Weatherlight since she revived the Powerstone.
timeline.quote: It had been happening since she had brought the Powerstone back to life.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana drives off a kavu and goblin hunters while guarding the camp.
timeline.quote: So far she had to drive off a kavu, its tongue aflame, and violently discourage a small hunting party of goblins

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Farim reports a lone man approaching the camp at night.
timeline.quote: Mari spotted someone coming.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana confronts the traveler and recognizes a vampire in Benalish armor.
timeline.quote: There was no mistaking what he was.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad identifies himself as a captured knight made a vampire.
timeline.quote: I'm Arvad, Knight of Benalia. I was captured and made a vampire.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad says he fights the Cabal and sometimes feeds in battle.
timeline.quote: I fight the Cabal whenever I can.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad says his compulsion lessened the night the Powerstone woke.
timeline.quote: It was on the night of the full moon, two months ago.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana lets Arvad try the Powerstone as a possible cure.
timeline.quote: It's worth a shot,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The crew sees Arvad's fangs have shrunk.
timeline.quote: Definitely smaller.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The crew allows Arvad to stay outside camp under Tiana's watch.
timeline.quote: he can stay but not in our camp, and you must pledge to watch him.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad loses his sensitivity to sunlight under the Powerstone's influence.
timeline.quote: Under the Powerstone's influence, Arvad had lost his vampiric sensitivity to sunlight

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana tells Arvad that Jhoira is the legendary one and the legends are true.
timeline.quote: She is that Jhoira, and those aren't legends, they're all true.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana confides that her purpose was destroyed before she arrived.
timeline.quote: I was supposed to guard a great machine, but it was destroyed before I got there.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad tells Tiana she can find a new purpose.
timeline.quote: Just because your original reason for existence was destroyed doesn't mean you can't get another one.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: A giant burning phoenix swoops on the Weatherlight camp.
timeline.quote: Streaking toward them from the mountains was a phoenix.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The phoenix burns Tiana, melts her spear and sets tents ablaze.
timeline.quote: Her spear was a melted lump.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Empowered by Serra, Tiana drives her sword into the phoenix and pushes it into the sea.
timeline.quote: Tiana shot up into the fire and drove her sword in right under its breastbone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tien credits Arvad with saving the camp and the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Arvad saved us,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana resolves to serve on the Weatherlight when Jhoira returns.
timeline.quote: It wasn't the purpose she had been born for, but it was the one she wanted more than anything.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The group resolves to capture a high-level Cabal agent for intelligence about the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We need to capture a high-level Cabal agent.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot grows in the dark, learning the voices of the crew, including Tiana and Arvad.
timeline.quote: This Cabal agent has been able to fool an entire academy of mages

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad finds Slimefoot and its sprouts in the storage space beside the engine compartment, and Slimefoot waves back at him and Tiana.
timeline.quote: Slimefoot freed a second armstalk and waved at both of them.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff identifies Slimefoot as a thallid that probably came aboard as a spore on the tree elemental seed Jhoira used, and notes it already has about ten babies.
timeline.quote: This one probably came aboard as a spore, stuck to that tree elemental seed Jhoira used to regrow the hull.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana decides to leave the thallids where they are while she goes to speak to Jhoira.
timeline.quote: Right, let's just leave it where it is right now. I'm going to talk to Jhoira.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot and its sprouts leave their den and meet Liliana, who asks Arvad how he resisted drinking blood.
timeline.quote: How did you decide not to eat people?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad explains he held on to an image of himself before he was changed, and Liliana learns there is no trick; she threatens Tiana and Arvad not to tell anyone about the talk.
timeline.quote: And if you tell anyone we had this conversation, you'll both regret it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha pries open Yargle's jaws and frees the Weatherlight, then bears Yargle down into the swamp.
timeline.quote: Muldrotha extruded a limb made of rotting wood and corpses into Yargle's clamped jaw and pried it open.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana deflects Urgoros's spear to save Liliana, and Jaya, Karn, Tiana and Arvad drive it off the ship.
timeline.quote: Tiana suddenly landed in front of her.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Tiana keep their crew together by deciding the bargain with the Church of Serra requires eradicating the Cabal from all of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: I thought it was to eradicate the Cabal from all of Dominaria.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana warns Shanna that the Phyrexian disguise is damaging the Weatherlight, then a screech signals an attack.
timeline.quote: A screech like nothing Shanna had heard sliced through the air

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The crew finds the Weatherlight grounded in Otaria with cracked moderator rods, and Raff proposes seeking magic in the mountains.
timeline.quote: "I think that dragon was guarding something," Raff said.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Shanna, Raff and Tiana find a smoky, magic-eating barrier, and Braids appears and offers help if they kill her shard-self.
timeline.quote: "I help you get inside the barricade, and you help me kill me."

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Braids opens four corridors in the barrier, and each of the three walks through alone.
timeline.quote: Four gaps had opened in the barrier, smooth sided and narrow.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The three emerge on the other side at different times and find the Phyrexian war construct sunk in a crater.
timeline.quote: the half-sunken hulk of a Phyrexian war machine

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Shard-Braids attacks the crew, Braids returns, and together they defeat the shard, which Braids absorbs.
timeline.quote: like an avalanche that buried the shard whole.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Braids reveals she was holding the shard back, and Tiana starts gathering parts from the war construct.
timeline.quote: I think . . . I need to start gathering parts."

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight has become a Phyrexian monstrosity, and Shanna and Tiana enter to recover the powerstone.
timeline.quote: a glance was enough to know it wasn't the Weatherlight anymore.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Inside, Shanna destroys tentacles wearing the heads of Botono, Ulaten and Anyxni and frees Slimefoot and the powerstone.
timeline.quote: One thrust, and Botono's death was final

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Shanna, Tiana and Slimefoot escape the ship, which flies away in its transformed state.
timeline.quote: Tiana squeezed Shanna and Slimefoot close and leapt out of the hatch.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Cabal summoners drag Braids back from dementia space; she escapes split in two and allies with Shanna, Tiana and Rafwyn to kill her shard-self.
timeline.quote: Braids escaped from her dementia space during the second Phyrexian invasion, but split in two.

citation.text: "Braids", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sixty years after the Mending Jhoira raises the wreck, restores it with a new hull seed, and assembles a crew against Belzenlok's Cabal.
timeline.quote: Jhoira led an expedition off the coast of Urborg to raise the remains of the Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "Reconstruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: He saved her and the Weatherlight.
relations.quote: I think he saved you, too.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

relations.note: They work closely together on the skyship.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

relations.note: called to be Tiana's friend and helper
relations.quote: who the white star had called from across the world to be Tiana's friend and helper.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

relations.note: Jhoira wants to keep her crew together
relations.quote: But Jhoira didn't want to break up their crew.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

relations.note: Rescued by Tiana and Shanna from the engine room.
relations.quote: Tiana squeezed Shanna and Slimefoot close and leapt out of the hatch.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

pages_say.description: An angel sent by the Church of Serra who feels an affinity for the Weatherlight and revives its Powerstone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

pages_say.description: An angel of Serra on the Weatherlight's crew.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

pages_say.description: An angel who steers the Weatherlight and rescues Niambi.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

pages_say.description: A member of the Weatherlight's crew who takes the wheel.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

pages_say.description: An angel who guided the ship's rebirth and is a member of its crew; she discovers Slimefoot.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

pages_say.description: The Weatherlight's pilot who steers the ship toward the old battlefield.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

pages_say.description: An angel and pilot of the Weatherlight who joins the fight against Urgoros and agrees to keep working with Jhoira.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

pages_say.description: A winged member of the Weatherlight crew.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

pages_say.description: An angelic artificer of the Weatherlight crew who fears the disguised ship is breaking and cuts out its powerstone.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

pages_say.description: Ally of Braids against her shard-self.

citation.text: "Braids". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Restarted the Weatherlight's original powerstone engine.

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
